promotion_evidence: Duplicated context produced NO_GAIN; omitted required context and random truncation produced ABSTAIN with zero credited savings.
demotion_or_retirement_evidence: Shuffled-role unexpectedly preserved the accepted outcome with 2 fewer input tokens, so it is published as CONTRADICTORY and the general micro-context causal interpretation is not promoted.
invalidating_assumption: The result is bounded to qwen2.5:0.5b, Ollama 0.30.10/llama.cpp, qwen2.5 tokenizer, issue-8624-v1 frozen task, warm-prefix posture, and campaign issue-8624-v1-negative-controls-v1; changing any envelope field or losing authoritative usage invalidates it.
